pythonFunction.name: find_payment_locations
pythonFunction.description:
Finds up to five places where the customer can pay in person, such as offices and retail
partners, near a ZIP code or city. Works for guests. Before calling this tool, speak a brief
conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.
    zip_or_city: ZIP code or city name the customer gives (REQUIRED).

Returns:
    dict with ok, matched_area and locations (name, address, hours, cash_accepted, type);
    matched_area is false when the nearest list is returned instead of an exact match.
